title: Global Meet-Up #2 (Los Angeles):  The "End of the World" US Tour
summary:
On Saturday, August 8, 2026, Professor Jiang spoke at the Kinn (https://thekinn.co/) in Venice, California.  Many thanks to Ally Fekaiki for organizing and moderating the event.  Because of his generosity, participation was free.     

You can learn more about Ally's work by subscribing to his YouTube channel:  https://www.youtube.com/@PrettyGreatPod
